pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark patches exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters with frequent acute-angle vertices. The geometry transitions from elongated, diamond-like polygons on the neck to larger, more complex amorphous polygons on the flank region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous topological graph with predominantly tri-nodal intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section, narrowing slightly at several junction nodes on the lower neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck ridge shows a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette, appearing as a fine, jagged edge against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, bulbous protrusion is visible on the lower ventral-lateral aspect of the neck, presenting as a significant volumetric anomaly and disruption of the natural body contour.
